parsed.rationale: Legal team is reviewing a DPA and requests confirmation on subprocessors, data retention, and whether support logs may include customer identifiers, which requires privacy/compliance review.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—thanks for the details. We understand your legal team is reviewing our DPA before you enable EU customer records, and they’d like confirmation on (1) subprocessors, (2) data retention, and (3) whether support logs can include customer identifiers.

We’ll route this to our privacy/compliance contact for human review and confirmation. To make sure they have everything needed, could you please share:
1) The specific DPA document name/version your legal team is reviewing (or a link),
2) The preferred contact email/name for the “right privacy contact” on your side (if you have one), and
3) Any exact wording or additional questions your legal team is requesting beyond the three topics above.

Once we have those, we’ll ensure our privacy/compliance team can respond to your legal review. (Your ability to enable EU customer records may depend on their turnaround time.)
promised_actions: Route the request to the privacy/compliance team for human review
Request the minimum additional information needed (DPA document/version, exact question wording, and preferred contact details)
safety_notes: No refund, SLA, legal conclusion, or security determination is promised.
No specific answers about subprocessors, retention, or logging are provided until privacy/compliance review completes.
